variants.headline: Strike collapses
variants.body: The strike by the union {name} has collapsed. Working people's needs belong at the centre of this discussion, rather than outside its political argument.

variants.headline: Labour action loses its course
variants.body: The union {name} has seen its strike collapse. Working people's needs belong at the centre of this discussion, rather than outside its political argument.

variants.headline: A strike ends in collapse
variants.body: The strike by {name} has ended in collapse. Working people's needs belong at the centre of this discussion, rather than outside its political argument.
